chunks: For when Our apostles came to them with clear proofs, they boasted and exulted at the knowledge they possessed; but what they used to mock recoiled back on them,
ai.seo_question: What happened to the people when the messengers came with clear proofs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the tragic irony of the Banu Quraysh or earlier nations who, despite possessing scriptural knowledge, rejected the Prophet due to pride and worldly attachment. Their 'joy' in their own knowledge signifies a spiritual blindness where intellectual arrogance overrides divine truth, leading to the 'encircling' punishment they had previously mocked.
